itens.trecho: Para rir até não aguentar mais. O filme é ligeiramente inspirado por uma banda-desenhada gótica onde uma máscara é responsável pelas atitudes irracionais e perigosas de várias pessoas.

Jim Carrey is the drippy bank-clerk "Ipkiss" who is always looking for love but who never seems to make much progress. Then one night he spots something floating in the river. Thinking it's a man, he goes to the rescue but it turns out to just be a mask that we know has recently been released from a locked casket deep beneath the waves.

Not as good as I remember, still an amusing watch regardless. It's been many, many years since I last watched 'The Mask' , hence why I hadn't had it logged on here before now, and while it isn't as funny or as quotable as I thought it would be (I remember really liking it as a kid), there is still enough in there that I got much entertainment from.
